promise.heading: Install and update agent skills and instructions, resolved to exact versions.
promise.secondary: Works with Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI and OpenCode. Instructions become managed sections of each agent's instruction file, upstream changes are previewed before you apply them, and the same instructions render for ChatGPT.
promise.description: Install and update the skills and instructions of Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI and OpenCode, resolved to exact versions.
